text:
Maya (Marketing): Heads up — Oakland DevSat pop-up on Apr 28. We have a 10x10 table, 45-minute lightning slot at 11:30, and estimated 150 attendees. Need final decisions on: speaker submission, swag counts, courier + inbound lead routing.
Sam B.: For speaker sub — I submitted the talk abstract yesterday. Link to form is here: https://forms.gle/example. We should lock slides deadline: Apr 21?
Priya R.: I can own slides. What template do we use — product or branding-first?
Maya (Marketing): Branding-first please. Use the Redwood slide kit v3 (Drive->Marketing/Events/SlideKit). Deadline Apr 20 EOD so we can review.
Diego (Events): Logistics q: venue power is shared. Need 2x power strips, 1x 4k monitor (for demos), 2 chairs, and a small lockbox for devices. Can ops ship those?
Ken - Growth: For lead capture — recommend QR -> short form -> HubSpot integration. Use UTM tags: ?utm_source=oakland_devsat&utm_medium=qr&utm_campaign=april_popup. Who can set auto-routing to SDR queue?
Chloe - Demand Gen: I'll build the QR form and set the HubSpot workflow. Routing rule: MQL score >= 30 -> SDR_A, else nurture sequence (webinar invite). I'll draft nurture copy after we confirm attendee list.
Priya R.: Slide question: do we want to include our benchmark snippet on latency/cost? Might be good for credibility during the lightning talk.
Maya (Marketing): Yes — include 2-slide micro-bench: latency vs cost graph + one-liner. Use the benchmark blurb from last week's report (Marketing/Benchmarks/April). Keep it high-level.
Sam B.: Quick swag check — we ordered 150 stickers, 100 shirts (mix S-XL), 150 branded pens, 75 pixel cards. Need to confirm shipping address and whether we want sticker trade-ins (people give email for sticker).
Diego (Events): Venue has 3pm load-out window. Courier pick-up should be scheduled for 3:30pm. Suggest pre-labeling boxes with this label:
```
Ship to: Oakland Event Center
Attn: Redwood Inference — Maya
Event date: Apr 28
Do not deliver before Apr 28 08:00
Courier: FastShip (tracking TBD)
```
Ken - Growth: For capture, include an explicit checkbox for webinar follow-up and a hidden field `initial_interest` with options [Embeddings, Chat, Dedicated]. Helps for routing.
Chloe - Demand Gen: I'll add that hidden field. Also recommend a post-event webinar 2 weeks after (May 12) — use the same benchmark narrative and invite list from QR leads.
Maya (Marketing): Action list: Priya — slides (due Apr 20). Sam — confirm swag final counts and sizing (due Apr 18). Diego — confirm power/monitor + courier (due Apr 22). Ken/Chloe — QR form + HubSpot workflow + nurture copy (due Apr 24). I'll own booth script and demo checklist.
Priya R.: Ack. Will use the slide kit and add the two benchmark slides.
Sam B.: Confirming swag: bump shirts to 125, keep stickers 150, pens 150. Changing pixel cards to 50. Ordering now.
ops-bot: Shipping label created for Redwood Inference — Pickup scheduled Apr 28 15:30, tracking 1Z999EXAMPLE.
Diego (Events): We need a backup demo laptop and a copy of the model weights for offline. Who can pack the micro-SSD image?
Maya (Marketing): Diego/Ken — pair up for backup image. Ken can create the README with commands; Diego will carry the SSD.
Ken - Growth: I'll drop the README in Drive /Events/Oakland/README.txt with these commands: `ssh demo@redwood -- rsync -av /models/weights /local` and a note about offline run: `python serve_demo.py --quantize`.
Chloe - Demand Gen: After event, cadence: Day0 email (thank you + slide deck), Day3 invite to webinar, Day10 personalized outreach from SDRs. I'll draft copy and circulate.
Maya (Marketing): One more — please all use the event Slack thread for real-time updates day-of. Assigning on-call: Sam will be point for booth, Diego for logistics, Priya for slides.
Sam B.: :thumbsup: Will bring multi-tool and battery pack.
Priya R.: :heart:
Diego (Events): I'll confirm power strips and monitor pickup tomorrow and post receipt here.
Maya (Marketing): Thanks team — we'll do a quick 15-min run on Apr 25 to rehearse booth flow.
